title: Departing Space Station Commander Provides Tour of Orbital Laboratory
summary: In her final days as ISS commander, Sunita Williams gives an extensive tour of the station's modules and research facilities, narrating the work done aboard.
why: Recommended as a great, understandable tour of life and equipment aboard the International Space Station.

quote.text: There's a great 25 minute tour of the ISS by Sunita Williams on NASA's YouTube channel
